privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.subtitle: What this instance stores about you and why.
privacy.whatBody: Your name, email address and profile picture; the workspaces you belong to and your role in them; the notifications and activity that your workspaces generate; and your notification preferences. Sign-in uses a one-time email code or your Google or GitHub account, so no password is stored.
privacy.whoBody: Members of a workspace see your name, picture and role in it, and the activity you perform there. Other people on this instance cannot see your data. The person who runs this instance can access the database.
privacy.controlBody: You can download everything tied to your account, and you can delete your account from your personal information settings. Deleting your account removes your profile, notifications and preferences.
